# Infra Checklist: Retention And Deletion Execution

**Purpose**: Validate persistence, migrations, worker/operator, backup, RLS, and validation requirements quality before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are new persistent lifecycle entities defined with `workspace_id`, ownership, timestamps, and tenant isolation requirements? [Completeness, Data Model §New Persistent Entities]
- [x] CHK002 Are meeting lifecycle columns specified for fast access blocking and list hiding? [Completeness, Data Model §Meeting Lifecycle Columns]
- [x] CHK003 Are RLS and maintenance/worker context expectations specified for deletion, report, retention, and local purge tables? [Infrastructure, Data Model §Privacy And RLS]
- [x] CHK004 Are active server purge classes enumerated across audio objects, transcript/diarization rows, summaries, exports, shares, temp uploads, workflows, and indexes? [Coverage, Lifecycle Contract §Active Server Purge Classes]
- [x] CHK005 Are backup expiry states specified separately from active server purge completion? [Coverage, Spec FR-009]
- [x] CHK006 Is retention policy snapshotting specified before retention-triggered deletion actions? [Completeness, Data Model §RetentionPolicySnapshot]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK007 Are retention jobs required to fail closed when configuration is absent or unsafe? [Consistency, Spec FR-014, Lifecycle Contract §Retention Job Rules]
- [x] CHK008 Are deletion reports designed to survive private content purge without retaining private content? [Consistency, Spec FR-007, Data Model §MeetingDeletionReport]
- [x] CHK009 Are desktop purge tasks scoped to registered devices and compatible with future non-macOS clients? [Consistency, Local Purge Contract]
- [x] CHK010 Are local validation commands and full `./infra/scripts/ci-local.sh` closure documented? [Dependency, Quickstart §Full Local Gate]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK011 Can migration/RLS tests objectively prove tenant isolation for lifecycle tables? [Measurability, Plan Source Code]
- [x] CHK012 Can retention scan tests cover eligible, not-yet-eligible, processing, deleting, deleted, blocked, and unsafe-policy states? [Measurability, Spec SC-005]

## Notes

- Infra checklist passes. The plan adds a dedicated lifecycle layer without weakening existing Postgres, MinIO, Temporal, MediaScribe, Langfuse, or desktop credential boundaries.
